blocks.text:
In the morning, you will go on another safari in search of jaguars. Afterwards, transfer to the airport for your flight to Rio de Janeiro. On arrival, transfer to the hotel.

Rio offers a very different setting: green hills, Guanabara Bay, the ocean and long beaches. Copacabana, Ipanema and Leblon are known for their black-and-white mosaic promenades, beach cafés and lively waterfront. Football and volleyball games begin on the sand early in the morning, open-air cafés along the shore serve coconut water and fresh juices, and musicians perform on the beaches. Active pursuits available in the city include surfing, diving, tennis, golf, rafting and hang gliding. The rest of the day is yours to explore independently.

blocks.text:
The half-day tour begins with an ascent to Urca Hill. There is a restaurant and bar at the viewing area, and the cable car continues up to Sugar Loaf.

From the summit, you can see Copacabana, the bay, the islands, the Niterói Bridge and the statue of Christ on Corcovado. After descending, the tour continues through the city. Accommodation at Arena Leme Copacabana, dinner and overnight.
